about_the_game:
A VISUAL NOVEL WHERE ANYTHING CAN HAPPEN

Dropkick Rick is a bold, fast-paced visual novel where your choices shape a series of unpredictable and oddly charming situations. You play as Rick, a has-been wrestler with too much confidence and too little luck. He’s impulsive, stubborn, full of bravado, but also weirdly charming in his cluelessness. Through branching choices and comic-strip storytelling, you’ll stumble through everything from awkward promos to bizarre dates to questionable career moves.

BUILT FOR LAUGHS, NOT LECTURES

This interactive story keeps it short, sharp, and silly. Each route is quick, packed with full voice over, dumb jokes, and endings that go in all sorts of directions. No melodrama, no filler, just fast playthroughs driven by curiosity and terrible ideas, especially if you’re the kind of player who wants to see how bad things can get. 

REPLAYABLE, MESSY, AND FULL OF BAD IDEAS

You won’t need a strategy. Just pick what feels right... or wrong. With comic-book visuals, branching narratives, and a pile of endings to discover, Dropkick Rick is made to be played more than once, preferably with bad judgment. 

Don’t forget to add Dropkick Rick to your Wishlist to get notified on launch!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Compatible with Intel and Apple Silicon via Rosetta.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 and above
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz+ Dual-Core
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: not supported
  • Additional Notes: Game is fully offline. Supports keyboard and mouse input.
